imports.shortDescription:
Available in sizes ranging from 6 to 14 inches, our range of crystal singing bowls are meticulously tuned to produce harmonious and resonant tones. Crafted from high-quality crystal, these bowls not only produce beautiful sounds but also emit powerful vibrational frequencies that promote relaxation and healing.

Every crystal singing bowl comes with a mallet and cushion, ensuring you have everything you need to begin your sonic journey. Whether you’re a seasoned sound healer or new to the world of sound therapy, our crystal singing bowls offer a versatile and accessible way to enhance your well-being.
imports.notes: No separate Woo SKU line for individual coloured bowls; sizes/prices/images from Crystal Bowls (9777). Name uses Chakra Coloured term from Set of 7.

imports.description:
Experience the profound resonance and therapeutic effects of our Shruthi Thali also known as Gong plates, crafted to bring harmonic balance and transformation to sound healing practice.
These tuned sonic plates and bells are calibrated to the complete musical scale in the 4th octave—C, D, E, F, G, A, B—and also available as a complete set of 7.
Each piece has been meticulously crafted to produce pure tones that can add a new soundscape to your musical journeys.

The Shruthi Thali ranges in size from the larger 12.5 inch by 8.5 tuned inch plate tuned to C4 to the more compact 10 inch by 6.5 inch version tuned to B4, with weights varying between 2kg for the C4 plate and 1.24kg for the Smaller B4 plate.
Each set includes an elegantly designed wooden holder and plate, a cover and a mallet creating both a functional sound instrument and a beautiful addition to your sacred or therapeutic environment.

Elevate your sonic healing practice with this extraordinary set designed to attune your surroundings to the fundamental harmonies of existence.

imports.shortDescription:
Our Solar Bell is a beautifully crafted sound healing instrument designed to elevate your meditation and relaxation practices. Inspired by ancient traditions and often associated with sacred frequencies, solar bells are known to support energetic alignment and inner harmony.

While many solar bells are traditionally tuned to 432 Hz, our Solar Bell is precisely tuned to 528 Hz — a frequency often referred to as the “love frequency,” believed to encourage transformation, balance, and deep healing. Subtle design influences inspired by ancient Egyptian cosmology add a symbolic dimension, connecting sound with timeless spiritual wisdom.

With a compact size of 19.5 cm, this Solar Bell is easy to handle and perfect for personal rituals, sound baths, or therapeutic sessions. It comes complete with a mallet, allowing you to begin your sound journey right away.
